sloka: अश्वैरश्वान् गजैर्नागान् योधैर्योधान् रथै रथान् ।स कपिर्नाशयामास सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान् ।। ५.४६.३७।।।।
transliteration: aśvairaśvān gajairnāgān yodhairyodhān rathai rathān ।sa kapirnāśayāmāsa sahasrākṣa ivāsurān ।। 5.46.37।।।।

translations.english: The vanara pitted horses against horses, elephants against elephants, warriors against warriors and chariots against chariots as Indra destroyed demons.
